subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word:

**Foment**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (4)** i.e. Instigate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Foment** means to instigate or stir up an undesirable or problematic situation like violence or discontent. (उकसाना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of fomenting rebellion among the troops.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Instigate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained:

 
• **Incite** (उकसाना):

 
 
• This word is similar to foment and means to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behavior.
 
• **Example: **They were charged with inciting the crowd to violence.
 
 
 
• **Stir** (हलचल मचाना):
 
 
• This word means to mix or cause to move briskly, but in the context of emotions or actions, it can mean to provoke or arouse.
 
• **Example: **His speech stirred the people to action.
 
 
 
• **Quash** (दबाना):
 
 
• This word is the opposite of foment and means to put an end to, suppress, or annul.
 
• **Example: **The government aims to quash any dissenting voices.
